key: Careful out there. Byxbysion is beyond the limits of the Reborn Region.
en: Careful out there. Byxbysion is beyond the limits of the Reborn Region.
ja: 気をつけろよ。ビクスビジョンは　リボーン地方の　外だからな

key: If anything happens, city officials will not be able to reach you to help.
en: If anything happens, city officials will not be able to reach you to help.
ja: 何かあっても　市の職員は　助けに　行けない
ビクス　ビジュ　オン……
ビクスビジョンは　実に　興味深い場所だ!

key: It knows no rhyme nor reason, and objects from across the region seem to appear there at a whim!
en: It knows no rhyme nor reason, and objects from across the region seem to appear there at a whim!
ja: 理屈も　筋道も　通じない。地方じゅうの　あらゆる物が　気まぐれに　現れるんだ!
